changed: The invariant and LIMITS of the obligation record fleet-host-loss-takes-each-lost-shard-over-on-its-named-standby-with-one-owner-per-tenure. Each round of a host scenario from the hosts' start on records its runnable actors (every running host, every tenure that steps and every running reconciler, or one idle candidate when the round has none) as one forced decision, and a tape replayed under a script whose round holds another set of them is refused with Candidates at that round's decision before any actor of the round steps. Before this change the fleet's round loop recorded no runnable-actor choice, so a replay did not detect a changed set of runnable actors. The LIMITS state that the decision records the set and not the order, that the owner processes a host runs beside its serving tenures (a named standby's wait, an unnamed host's wait, and every owner process the host loop runs between rounds: a queued takeover, restart or rerun, a fresh activation) are no candidates, that the boot rounds before the hosts start record no such decision, and that an operating-system helper thread's spawn outcome is recorded by no decision. The record fleet-volume-scenarios-pass-on-their-second-root-and-every-replacement-crash-cell reads "the records named" where it read "the two records named", in its invariant and in its reference, since its invariant names three records. The invariant of fleet-reconciler-keeps-the-census-under-its-cap-and-converges-on-one-designation counts each order of two reconcilers as one recorded decision beyond the host-loss run's with each round's runnable-actor decision left out of both counts, since a reconciler run and the host-loss run record different numbers of those decisions.

property_action.reason: Its invariant states the new contract and names the evidence: the host-loss recording replays to an equal report; the same tape under a script that also crashes a host with no tenure is refused with Candidates; one round replayed with a host stopped, or with every host stopped, keeps the refusal and steps no actor; and one round of a booted reconciler fleet replayed with one boot tenure out of its slot, or with its reconciler down, is refused with every host running. Its controls name the replay control and the violation it panics with.
